content.title: The Madison (TV Series 2026– ) ⭐ 8.0 | Action, Drama
content.text: TV Series2026– TV-MAA New York family's life unravels after a tragedy; they process their grief while vacationing in rural Montana, where they explore human connection amid their profound sorrow.A New York family's life unravels after a tragedy; they process their grief while vacationing in rural Montana, where they explore human connection amid their profound sorrow.A New York family's life unravels after a tragedy; they process their grief while vacationing in rural Montana, where they explore human connection amid their profound sorrow.178User reviews12Critic reviewsEpisodes12Videos4Featured reviewsA Wake-Up Call Wrapped in a Great StorySo far, The Madison is off to a strong start. Having grown up in Montana, it's great to see landscapes like that on screen again-the setting alone adds a lot to the show.The storyline feels like a real wake-up call. Not just for the characters, but for the audience as well. It confronts a lot of the issues and attitudes that seem common in this generation and puts them right out in the open.Michelle Pfeiffer is fantastic, as always. It's great to see her in a leading role where she really gets to carry the story. She brings the right level of emotion and depth to a character going through some very difficult circumstances, and it makes the performance feel believable.If you're looking for a solid drama with strong acting and a meaningful storyline, The Madison is definitely worth checking out.Character-Driven Drama That DeliversThe story pulls you in right away, and the characters feel real and layered - you actually care about what happens to them. The pacing is spot-on, balancing drama, tension, and quieter, emotional moments that hit hard.Taylor Sheridan does a fantastic job shaping the series, creating a strong atmosphere and a story that really feels lived-in. This isn't just drama for drama's sake - every choice, every conflict feels meaningful and grounded.Overall, it's a well-crafted, character-driven show that hooks you from the start and keeps you invested. Definitely worth watching if you enjoy emotional, story-first drama with tension and heart.Not your typical Sheridan show but it still worksAs a huge fan of almost everything that Taylor Sheridan does I've been looking forward to The Madison ever since I first heard about it. On top of it being a Sheridan show it has an incredible cast led by Kurt Russell and Michelle Pfeiffer. I wouldn't be shocked to see the both of them nominated for Emmy's for their work here. This isn't the best show Sheridan has done but it's still a good one. It's actually very different and if you didn't already know Sheridan was the creator you probably wouldn't guess it by how different it is from his previous shows. I think this will appeal to multiple audiences from age to gender. It has something for everyone.Great storyI am loving this series! Sheridan is great a casting! These characters are raw! As in Yellowstone the scenery is incredible! This is a TS show your mom will love! A main character is killed off early , but still creatively has a huge part in the story! It needed to happen this way for the story to begin!I enjoyed this show but...This show is beautiful and a great way to show that being out in nature can heal and is more powerful than anything else. The character Abby I found a bit immature for her age. Which is annoying. And of course there's a dumb blonde in Taylor's work but at least it's called out in the show. It was nice to see spoiled entitlement called out and was glad to see the Cowboy not be used by the character Abby. I respected him more.
